targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, sum(bits_per_sec) AS bits_per_sec
FROM
(
    SELECT
        toDateTime(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(flow_start, INTERVAL 30 SECOND)) + bucket_index * 30) AS time,
        bytes * 8 / greatest(dateDiff('second', flow_start, flow_end), 1) AS bits_per_sec
    FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
    ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(greatest(1, intDiv(greatest(dateDiff('second', flow_start, flow_end), 1) + 29, 30)))) AS bucket_index
    WHERE flow_end >= $__fromTime AND flow_start <= $__toTime
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Observed Traffic Throughput
panels.description: Duration-spread throughput: each flow is converted to average bps using flow_start/flow_end and spread across every 30-second bucket touched by the flow. This avoids active-timeout exports appearing as spikes at received_at or flow_start.

targets.rawSql: SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY dst_name, dst_addr ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT received_at, src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, proto, src_port, dst_port, bytes, packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, count() / 30 AS flows_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, sum(packets) / 30 AS packets_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT src_name AS device, src_addr, src_device_type, src_vendor, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) AND (startsWith(src_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.31.')) GROUP BY device, src_addr, src_device_type, src_vendor ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT src_org_or_name AS src_name, src_addr, dst_org_or_name AS dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY src_name, src_addr, dst_name, dst_addr, dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT dst_port, proto, sum(bytes) AS total_bytes, formatReadableSize(total_bytes) AS readable_bytes, count() AS flows, sum(packets) AS packets FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY dst_port, proto ORDER BY total_bytes DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT time, sum(bits_per_sec) AS bits_per_sec
FROM
(
    SELECT
        toDateTime(toUnixTimestamp(toStartOfInterval(flow_start, INTERVAL 30 SECOND)) + bucket_index * 30) AS time,
        bytes * 8 / greatest(dateDiff('second', flow_start, flow_end), 1) AS bits_per_sec
    FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external
    ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(greatest(1, intDiv(greatest(dateDiff('second', flow_start, flow_end), 1) + 29, 30)))) AS bucket_index
    WHERE flow_end >= $__fromTime AND flow_start <= $__toTime
      AND proto='UDP' AND (dst_port=443 OR src_port=443)
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(received_at, INTERVAL 30 SECOND) AS time, count() / 30 AS rows_per_sec FROM flow_poc.flows_enriched_external WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

OR startsWith(src_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.19.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.2') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.30.') OR startsWith(src_addr,'172.31.')) AND NOT (startsWith(dst_addr,'10.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'192.168.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.16.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.17.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.18.') OR startsWith(dst_addr,'172.19.')
